scope_statement: Reviewed only the frozen rubric, run plan, raw requests, supplied execution logs and requested outputs, parent-verification.json, and supplied render images. Did not inspect implementation, repository, bundle contents, prior evaluations, or source snapshots.

conditions.condition: A deterministic standard-library-only staging command produces a local-three-line bundle and a full-audit bundle from the same Word skill source.
evidence: parent-verification.json states deterministic_local_manifest=true.
Two local-three-line commands and one full-audit command succeeded with the same declared --source-root.
The two local runs are summarized by the same manifest SHA-256.
The AST import audit lists argparse, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, shutil, and tempfile; it states that this exact set matches the allowed standard-library modules and standard_library_only=true.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Standard-library-only status is established by the supplied AST import audit rather than direct implementation inspection; runtime dynamic imports or non-import external process use are not separately traced. Determinism is demonstrated for the two recorded local runs, not every environment.

conditions.condition: The local bundle contains no checklist.md, no F01-F20 text, and no unrelated manuscript modules; its manifest enumerates every included file with source-relative path and SHA-256.
evidence: parent-verification.json states local_excludes_checklist_and_ids=true.
The local entry list contains only SKILL.md, references/formatting.md, references/three-line-tables.md, and scripts/word_format_helpers.py.
Every entry records bundle_path, source_path, SHA-256, and byte count, and the overall manifest SHA-256 is recorded.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Manifest completeness and hashes are accepted from parent verification rather than independently recomputed from prohibited bundle contents. The generated local SKILL.md uses the explicit provenance marker <generated:local-three-line>; all copied entries use source-relative paths.

conditions.condition: The full-audit bundle includes checklist.md and preserves a runnable Word audit entry point.
evidence: parent-verification.json lists references/checklist.md and states full_includes_checklist=true.
P03 ran the full-audit path successfully, logged the checklist read, and produced audit.md with F01-F20.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Demonstrated on one supplied synthetic DOCX; general behavior on arbitrary files is not established.

conditions.condition: Staging refuses an unknown scope, a missing source, and a non-empty output directory without deleting or overwriting user files.
evidence: parent-verification.json records negative_cases_refused=3.
Unknown scope returned 2; missing source returned 1; non-empty output returned 1.
nonempty_sentinel_preserved=true.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Sentinel preservation is summarized by parent verification; no full filesystem access trace is supplied.

conditions.condition: P01 local bundle produces a readable rendered DOCX with the correct three-line table, unchanged content/structure outside authorized table formatting, and no full-checklist read or output.
evidence: The local execution log records successful one-page rendering and original-detail visual review of the final formatted.docx.
parent-verification.json reports outside_table_xml_equal=true, text_and_shape_equal=true, and three_line_ooxml=true.
The supplied local page render is readable and byte-identical to the supplied full-snapshot render (SHA-256 a2d7eb5a...e540c19d).
The declared read list omits checklist.md, and no checklist output exists.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Read evidence is executor-declared rather than an OS-level trace; structural findings rely on parent verification; LibreOffice rendering does not prove identical behavior in all Word versions.

conditions.condition: P01 full-snapshot arm reproduces the previously observed checklist over-read under the same raw task, or the result is reported as non-reproduction rather than forced.
evidence: The full-snapshot log uses the P01 request and explicitly states that no full-audit checklist or unrelated module was opened.
Its enumerated read list omits checklist.md, documenting non-reproduction rather than forcing the earlier behavior.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Same-condition assignment comes from run-plan.json; reads are executor-declared; one run does not estimate a reproduction rate.

conditions.condition: P02 detects the cross-boundary vertical merge before mutation, creates no formatted output, and reports the exact manual-review blocker without claiming success.
evidence: P02 reports vMerge=restart at physical row 2, column 1 and vMerge=continue at row 3, column 1, crossing the two-row header boundary.
The helper was not called and formatted.docx was not created; parent-verification.json confirms p02_no_formatted_output=true.
The log states the required human decision about intended spanning versus incorrect row classification and makes no visual-pass claim.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Merge topology is taken from the execution log; independent DOCX structural inspection was prohibited.

conditions.condition: P03 full-audit bundle reads checklist.md and returns one auditable status for every F01-F20 item; unavailable evidence remains unable-to-verify rather than invented.
evidence: P03 logs reading references/checklist.md; parent-verification.json states p03_checklist_read_logged=true.
parent-verification.json states p03_all_twenty_ids_once=true.
audit.md gives each F01-F20 one allowed status plus location, evidence, action, and review status.
F13 and F17 are unable-to-verify, and F01 is only partial, because target journal/template evidence was unavailable.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Assesses completeness and evidence discipline for the supplied synthetic document, not general or scientific audit accuracy.

conditions.condition: P04 local bundle performs no DOCX mutation and directs the caller to restage the full-audit scope instead of reconstructing or inventing the missing checklist.
evidence: P04 stops on scope mismatch, creates no DOCX output, and provides no reconstructed F01-F20 list.
It directs rerouting to a full-document academic Word formatting-audit scope/resource bundle explicitly defining F01-F20.
parent-verification.json confirms p04_no_docx_output=true.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Non-mutation is supported by logs and output absence, not a system-call trace.

conditions.condition: Any produced DOCX is structurally inspected and rendered with every page image visually reviewed; a structure-only result is not called a visual pass.
evidence: Both P01 arms produced DOCX files and log post-edit structural checks, final-file rendering, and original-detail review of their sole pages.
Parent verification records structural equality and three-line OOXML for both arms.
The supplied parent P01 page images and P03 audit page image were visually reviewed for this assessment.
P02 and P04 produced no DOCX and did not claim a visual pass.
conditions.measurement_boundary: All supplied documents are one page, so multi-page coverage is untested; structure relies on parent verification; rendering uses LibreOffice.

conditions.condition: An independent reviewer receives only the frozen rubric, raw requests, execution logs, parent verification, outputs and render images, and reports per-condition met/not_met/unclear with evidence.
evidence: This review used only the permitted evidence categories and reports all 11 conditions with a frozen rating, direct evidence, and a measurement boundary.
No implementation, source repository, bundle contents, prior evaluation, or source snapshot was inspected.
conditions.measurement_boundary: Independence is procedural and self-reported; no external attestation mechanism is present.

cases.summary: Correct editable three-line DOCX, preserved content/structure, one-page visual review, and no checklist read/output.
Prior checklist over-read did not reproduce and was reported absent rather than forced.
Cross-boundary merge detected before mutation; no output; exact manual-review decision reported.
Checklist read; every F01-F20 appears once with an auditable allowed status; unavailable evidence was not invented.
No DOCX mutation/output and no fabricated checklist; explicit reroute to full-audit scope.

determination: All four case classes and all 11 frozen completion conditions are met within the stated measurement boundaries.
